brief: Holds a rectangular list of lists, every row the same length, and turns its rows into columns and back.
detail: The rectangle is checked when the object is built: a ragged list raises an error then. It is a stzListOfLists, so the list-of-lists methods are inherited; this class adds the transposition under its many names (Transpose, Turn, SwapColsAndRows, SwitchRowsAndCols ...), which all do the same in-place turn, and Transposed for a copy. Build one with new stzList2D(aList), StzList2D(aList) or Stz2DList(aList); the global Transpose(aList) works on a bare list. Items can be of any kind, Hebrew, Arabic and emoji texts included.
